The '''LLS-3 landspeeder''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It measured four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and could carry a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], up to four passengers, and 50 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo.<ref name="Talnar" />
